Changed.description: A command that wrote the profile: the host's other views read it again, and Undo restores the version before.
Changed.title: Changed

Choice.description: One entry of a filter drop-down: the value it filters by ("" for all) and its label.
Choice.title: Choice

InstallEdit.description:
One edit. field: name | id | variant | overhaul | tick | place_last | rebuild | after_last | library | native |
table | file. key: the file or tick; text: the new text or choice; on: the check; kind: early | after | init.
InstallEdit.title: InstallEdit

LaunchRef.description: The profile as the setup the shell launches: kind "me3" or "manifest" (an overhaul installer's), and its source.
LaunchRef.title: LaunchRef

Line.description: A muted line under a group header: "2 folders ... are not loaded · Add..." or "<entry> loads nothing".
Line.title: Line

ModsView.description:
The Mods page for one profile: what the presenter shows, the Load order panel (every clash; a client cuts the
list), the entries (for the options and rename dialogs) and what the header menu needs.
ModsView.title: ModsView

Notice.description:
One InfoBar: key says what it is (online, stale, allow-tool, recovered), so the adapter knows what its action
does.
Notice.title: Notice

OptionsView.description:
What the Mod options dialog shows for one entry. init_kind: 0 none, 1 call a function, 2 wait (ms); overlay: -1
when it does not apply, else 0/1 (the parameter overlay set by hand).
OptionsView.title: OptionsView

OverhaulMenu.description:
The header overflow's overhaul entries (an overhaul installed with the launcher, a preview): shown while the
switch is on and the game has an overhaul the launcher can install (owner, D4 A).
OverhaulMenu.title: OverhaulMenu

PickOffer.description: A tick list to show: its words and rows (kind "pick"), or None when there is nothing to choose.
PickOffer.title: PickOffer

PlanOffer.description:
A plan operation's answer: a question to show (prompt: kind confirm | pick | choose, plus its words) and the
plan_id to answer on POST /v1/plans/{plan_id}; or, with plan_id null, a refusal (kind refusal: title and body).
PlanOffer.title: PlanOffer

get.description: Ordered job events. `id` is the seq, `event` the type. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to continue.

post.description: Ask the job to stop (it ends with a `cancelled` event). Idempotent: a job that is over just reports its state.
Answer a plan the client was offered: runs it once. Errors: unknown_plan, plan_expired, plan_stale.
